## Breaking change

`fritz` has fully transitioned to configuration via UI. YAML configuration will be removed in an upcoming version. Existing YAML configuration will be imported automatically and can now safely be removed from your configuration files.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
First PR of a serie in order to include new functionalities to current Fritz integration.
Thxz to @mammuth and @AaronDavidSchneider that started https://github.com/mammuth/ha-fritzbox-tools.

Full code will have:

- Config flow
- Device tracker
- Binary sensor
- Switches
- Services

and some common parts.
